definitions.explanation: Equipment and implements used for cleaning, such as brooms, mops, dustpans, and buckets.

examples.japanese: {掃除用具|そうじようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧しまう。
examples.english: To put away the cleaning tools.

examples.japanese: {掃除用具|そうじようぐ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ロッカー→ロッカー：09734_rokkaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れてある→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: The cleaning supplies are in the hallway locker.

examples.japanese: ⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧たち⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{掃除用具|そうじようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: At school, students use cleaning tools to clean the classroom themselves.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧ (cleaning) + ⟦{用具|ようぐ}→用具：09667_yougu⟧ (tools/equipment). In Japanese schools, students are responsible for daily classroom cleaning, so {掃除用具|そうじようぐ} and the {掃除用具入|そうじようぐい}れ (cleaning supply cabinet) are familiar fixtures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {掃除用具入|そうじようぐい}れ: cleaning supply cabinet
- {掃除用具|そうじようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to gather cleaning supplies
- {掃除用具|そうじようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to tidy up the cleaning tools

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {清掃用品|せいそうようひん}: cleaning products — slightly more formal and broader, including chemical cleaners
- {掃除道具|そうじどうぐ}: cleaning tools — a near-synonym using ⟦{道具|どうぐ}→道具：01479_dougu⟧ instead of ⟦{用具|ようぐ}→用具：09667_yougu⟧; both are interchangeable in everyday use
